name: computer-use-driver-wiring
summary: Use when auditing or debugging computer_use driver startup, spawn/schema wiring, embedded-daemon permissions, remote shims, or fresh-session routing.
intents_fr: Pourquoi computer_use plante au démarrage du driver ?
J’ai `embedded cua-driver exited during startup`, tu peux tracer le spawn ?
Le mode standard marche mais unrestricted casse : vérifie le contrat du daemon embarqué.
Mon shim remote refuse `serve`, regarde l’allowlist et les argv attendus.
On peut auditer comment HERMES_CUA_DRIVER_CMD est résolu et comment le manifest choisit mcp ?
Review cette diff du toolset computer_use : schema, approvals et backend registry.
Vérifie que le mode YOLO passe bien permission_mode=unrestricted jusqu’au backend.
Le manifest distant renvoie command vide : Hermes lance bien le shim local, pas le binaire du Mac ?
J’ai `remote driver subcommand is not allowed`, c’est quoi l’incompatibilité dans le wiring ?
Peux-tu vérifier le routage du premier appel computer_use dans une nouvelle session gateway ?
Le driver démarre, mais la tâche n’est pas validée : check les gates URL, fenêtre native et vérification finale.
On modifie le backend plugin : regarde les effets sur le schema model-facing, la precedence et l’injection de skills.
intents_en: Audit the embedded daemon contract for unrestricted mode.
Review this computer_use backend wiring diff.
Check remote shim manifest and serve routing.
Verify fresh-session computer_use routing and completion evidence.
symptoms: remote driver subcommand is not allowed
computer_use works in standard mode but fails in unrestricted mode
Fresh gateway session does not make the ordinary first device call
Driver process starts but URL, native window readiness, or final verification is missing
not_for: Choosing or executing GUI actions during a computer-use task.
Auditing screenshot, accessibility-tree, or capture integrity.
Configuring Walter’s remote computer-use route itself.
Inventorying remote CUA capabilities without investigating driver wiring.
